description:
Configure an auto-reply for the 'IT Support' mailbox. Navigate to Manage > Mailboxes > IT Support > Auto Reply. Enable the auto-reply and configure it with the following details:

- Subject: 'We've received your request - IT Support'
- Message Body must include these three specific details:
  1. Acknowledgment that the request will be reviewed 'within 24 hours'.
  2. A notice about scheduled maintenance on 'December 14-15'.
  3. An emergency contact number: '(555) 987-6543'.

Save the configuration once entered.

metadata.expected_subject: We've received your request - IT Support
